question: Which group was formed in 1919 to support the Khilafat Movement and strengthen the Hindu-Muslim unity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khilafat Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khilafat Committee was established in 1919 to protest against the injustices meted out to the Ottoman Caliphate after World War I and to protect its authority.
 
• It aimed to support the Khilafat Movement and foster Hindu-Muslim unity in the Indian independence struggle.
 
• The leaders of the Khilafat Movement included prominent figures like Maulana Mohammad Ali and Maulana Shaukat Ali, also known as the Ali Brothers.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi supported the Khilafat Movement, encouraging Indian Muslims and Hindus to work together against British colonial rule.
 
• The movement eventually merged with the Non-Cooperation Movement initiated by Gandhi, forming a united front against British oppression.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khilafat Movement:**

 
 
• The movement was a pan-Islamic political campaign launched by Indian Muslims to influence the British government and protect the Ottoman Caliphate after World War I.
 
• The Treaty of Sèvres (1920), which dismantled the Ottoman Empire, was a major catalyst for this movement.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Ali Brothers:**
 
 
• Maulana Mohammad Ali and Maulana Shaukat Ali were instrumental in leading the Khilafat Movement in India.
 
• They worked in collaboration with Mahatma Gandhi to ensure Hindu-Muslim unity during the struggle for independence.
 
 
 
• **Hindu-Muslim Unity:**
 
 
• The Khilafat Movement marked a rare period of collaboration between Hindus and Muslims in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• Gandhi's support for the movement was pivotal in bridging communal gaps temporarily.
 
 
 
• **Decline of the Movement:**
 
 
• The Khilafat Movement declined after Mustafa Kemal Atatürk abolished the Caliphate in 1924 and established a secular government in Turkey.
 
• This development weakened the relevance of the movement in India.
